description: The Slovenian National Institute of Public Health publishes survey results from two ANIMA project workshops on transparent noise management and community engagement around Ljubljana Airport. Zenodo provides an open Excel file of raw responses and a questionnaire document under CC BY 4.0. These observations can inform actor-response or engagement assumptions in airport-noise planning simulations, with the ANIMA deliverable cited as context for the local case. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workshop survey package. A limitation is that workshop participants are a selected group, not a representative sample of everyone exposed to airport noise. The public page does not state sample size, question scales, survey dates or quantified noise levels. It documents participant evaluation of workshops, not measured health, aircraft operations or the effectiveness of a built mitigation project. Both files were left unopened, and no response or statistical estimate was independently checked.
